table_demo.description: Current bottle demo. Table surface measured 2026-07-15 via head RGB-D + calibrated extrinsics: z=-0.205 in right_controller_base (median of clean patches -0.2072/-0.2085). Keepout top at -0.20; front edge y=0.36 chosen between the nearest visible table pixel (y=0.49, cut off by image bottom) and the demonstrated collision-free transit corridor (y=0.329, z=-0.49). T_moveit_from_profile measured 2026-07-19 by pairing SDK rm_algo FK (install angle [0,45,0]) with MoveIt /compute_fk over 17 saved real planning states after correcting the SDK zero-tool/controller-flange semantics: rotation is yaw 180deg and translation best-fit (-0.063111,-0.103489,-0.002710), with maximum position residual 9.7mm. The old identity-rotation transform placed every obstacle mirrored behind the robot. Historical table trials do not establish the current right-tool mount rotation; P0 audit therefore disables execution until tool_mount_calibration records the measured full chain.

shelf_template.description: 2026-07-20 现场实测（单个格位，货架第2层，用户口头量得整层70cm宽x29cm深x39cm高，5层共152cm）。首次测量误把瓶身水平结构当成 shelf_bottom，写入的 z=-0.1143 在 2026-07-20 20:49 site_check 中虚假拒绝了实测中心瓶子 base=[-0.1133, 0.6976, -0.1366]。20:54 用当前目标重测 shelf_bottom，7 帧共识、1683 个内点，安全余量后边界为 z=-0.2140，与保存深度帧独立点云核对一致。shelf_back 为真实背板，shelf_top z=0.1282 是保守边界。2026-07-21 移除 shelf_slot_left_guard/shelf_slot_right_guard：它们来自首轮左右相邻瓶子的一次性位置，不是固定货架结构；现场只有一瓶时会形成假碰撞。当前相邻物体改由每轮 RGB-D 体素碰撞场表达。21:40 现场重新示教的 home_joints_deg 保留为抓后 carry/home 目标，不再作为抓取起点。左臂过去不使用静态停靠目标；每轮启动时采集它当时的真实姿态作为 MoveIt 碰撞快照，并在右臂任务期间监控其保持不动。shelf_home_corridor 保持宽包络，真正路径由 MoveIt+实时 RGB-D 把关。output_joints_deg/output_point_base 仍为空。2026-07-24 G0.6 静态同关节状态验证确认 r_link7 到 controller flange 为 +Z 17.2 mm、flange 到 active bottle TCP 为 +Z 151 mm，完整链残差 0.0417213 mm/0.080326 deg；恢复 a4f3430 已现场验证的 shelf 执行兼容性。G2 run 20260724_191151_294662_490a95ed 又在真实起点与已示教 home 两个同关节状态采集 MoveIt r_link7/SDK link7 对；保留既有 yaw 180 deg，不猜新旋转，仅以两点对称残差重估 base-frame bridge 平移为 (-0.062292,-0.097784,0.008316)，两端最大位置残差 19.24 mm，低于未放宽的 25 mm runtime gate。2026-08-02 用户指定当前双臂姿态与升降 647 mm 为此后所有货架抓取的统一初始状态；三者必须作为原子门禁，不得与抓后 home/carry 混用。647 mm 下重复实测 shelf_bottom 保守顶面约 z=-0.2432，证据目录 /tmp/grabber_real_20260802_resume_1936。 2026-08-04 左臂 grasp_start 定为 [-51.2960,-115.3620,50.8940,-72.2810,13.7490,119.4910,12.6960]，由操作员手动摆位后落库，取代此前所有取值。以前每一个值都是「读左臂当时在哪就记下来」，一步校验都没有：08-02 那个 J6=126.406°，距 ±128° 控制器限位只剩 1.6°，落在 3° 安全余量带内，所以指向它的规划一次都不可能成功——直到 08-04 第一次真正规划左臂才暴露。本次落库前逐项验过：12 秒静止漂移 0.004°；关节余量最小 8.5°（J6）；TCP 在围栏系 [-0.2838,0.4097,-0.1938]，距走廊左边缘 0.441 m（旧值贴在边缘上，是之前所有路径一动就出界的原因）；MoveIt 自碰撞检查通过。这四项就是当初该做而没做的检查。 同日新增：左臂独立 MoveIt 规划通路（left_arm 规划组、按规划组附着工具防撞体、稠密复核按规划组取关节名）。左臂位姿即使与右臂数值相同，也必须依次通过右臂/升降预归位、左臂对应规划组和最终双臂+升降原子门禁，不构成绕过任一臂安全链的复用。 操作员随后确认已用当前记录完成一次左臂归位；这是自由空间归位通路验证，不等同于左臂抓取验证。 2026-08-04 首次完整循环试运行中，操作员确认 0.40 框高取点夹在瓶盖；当轮检测框高 179 px，取点比 2026-08-03 证据高 24.3 mm。将货架独立校准改为 0.55，把取点下移约 27 px；路径仍须通过 MoveIt 和稠密执行复核。 2026-08-12 删除 home_joints_deg：上面这段历史里提到的那个「抓后 carry/home 目标」已从全部 profile 移除。它与 grasp_start 相距 228°，而侧桌投放链路（建在 table_demo 之上）开场就要从收拢位横跨过去，当天四条路线三条被电子围栏拒（TCP x≈+0.60）、一条需要 41 条控制指令超过队列上限 30，没有一次 dispense 跑到货架。现在全项目只有一个示教停放位姿：双臂 grasp_start，右臂那一项由 SafetyProfile.taught_rest_joints_deg 提供。

tool_mount_calibration.evidence_id: nominal link7->flange->TCP offsets (DemoParams.moveit_link7_to_controller_flange_m + tcp_z_m); the residual offset is absorbed by DemoParams.grasp_stop_short_m, tuned on the real right arm until shelf grasps held. NOT metrology: do not transfer to the left arm, to another approach direction, or to a geometric grasp-point derivation without measuring first. The evidence_id here previously pointed at docs/handoff/hardware_validation_artifacts/g0_6_fe929e5_20260724T095101Z/static_fk_gate.raw.log, which has never existed in this repository and is excluded by .gitignore, alongside fabricated 0.042 mm / 0.080 deg residuals.

shelf_template.demonstrated_grasp_evidence_id: 2026-08-02 teleop demonstration, gripper_events.jsonl close event; the posture a person used to hold this shelf's bottle

left_tool_mount_calibration.evidence_id: Nominal RMG24 chain (the right arm's untouched T_link7_controller_flange, z=0.0172) with the left arm's measured tool-side constant folded in: Rz(-179.91 deg) and 87 mm, which is the 3.14 the URDF puts on l_joint7 and gives the right arm on joint1 instead. Hand-eye AX=XB over 24 joint states, no joint remapping; the fold direction was chosen by comparing all four compositions against MoveIt directly rather than by derivation. Residual 0.765 mm / 0.192 deg. Forward kinematics only, nothing commanded. An earlier attempt put the same 180 deg into negated joints 2, 4 and 6: it matched link7 to 0.5 mm and mirrored the elbow, which MoveIt reported as the arm hitting its own head. Endpoint agreement is not configuration agreement on a 7-DoF arm. No left grasp has held, so free-space only.

left_arm_model.method: moveit(q) = Bridge @ (flange(q) @ inv(L7F)) with the tool constant already folded into L7F. Derived once from the nominal record rather than from a profile edited in place, and every candidate fold checked against MoveIt's own FK before one was kept.

side_table_template.description: ENABLED 2026-08-12 at the operator's explicit direction, WITHOUT the full site survey this template was written to require. Provenance of every value: shelf_ready x/y/yaw/lift and source_lift_height_mm were read off the robot on 2026-08-12 with it facing the shelf at lift 647. transport_joints_deg reuses shelf_template.grasp_start_right_joints_deg -- the taught tuck the cross-layer cycle already carries a bottle to. Held-bottle geometry mirrors DemoParams. tcp_workspace/allowed_tcp_zones reuse shelf_template's measured envelope: same arm, arm-relative frame, so turning the body does not move it. keepout_boxes is empty -- no post-turn keepout was ever measured. rotation_sweep clearances (0.30) and the table fit/place parameters are UNMEASURED defaults; _assert_sweep cannot distinguish a measured number from a typed one, so the real protection for a whole-robot sweep is an operator watching with a hand on the e-stop. table_roi is a deliberately generous search volume, NOT a measured table position: _fit_one_height takes the modal z bin inside it, so if the floor contributes more points than the table it will be fitted as the table. Narrow the z window once the first observation reports a plausible table height. bottle_bottom_below_tcp_m (0.04) is no longer read for placement at all -- _servo_bottle_onto_table measures the TCP-to-bottle-bottom offset from the head camera, because the tool_mount_calibration chain below is nominal and its own evidence_id forbids transferring it to a geometric grasp-point derivation or to another approach direction. That tool_mount_calibration is a byte-for-byte copy of shelf_template's: _validate_side_table_profile_pair compares evidence_id and measured_at_utc as strings, so it must stay identical -- do not annotate it, explain it here instead. It is the identical physical tool on the identical arm. The right-arm-base to platform and right-arm-base to head-camera transforms stay invariant across lift; do not add lift height to either transform.

tool_mount_calibration.evidence_id: nominal link7->flange->TCP offsets (DemoParams.moveit_link7_to_controller_flange_m + tcp_z_m); the residual offset is absorbed by DemoParams.grasp_stop_short_m, tuned on the real right arm until shelf grasps held. NOT metrology: do not transfer to the left arm, to another approach direction, or to a geometric grasp-point derivation without measuring first. The evidence_id here previously pointed at docs/handoff/hardware_validation_artifacts/g0_6_fe929e5_20260724T095101Z/static_fk_gate.raw.log, which has never existed in this repository and is excluded by .gitignore, alongside fabricated 0.042 mm / 0.080 deg residuals.

keepout_boxes._note: Not a measured obstacle. shelf_template's keepouts describe the shelf itself, which is no longer in front of the arm once the body has turned -- reusing them would put a phantom wall across y 0.54..1.5, exactly where table_roi looks. What is authored instead is the one statement that stays true after any turn: nothing the arm does at the table has any business below the table. The ceiling is table_roi.min[2], so if the real tabletop were lower than this the fit would find no table at all and the run would abort before reaching here. The live guards on descent are _servo_bottle_onto_table's measured-offset bounds; this is only the static backstop under them.
